arXiv:2606.03736v1 [stat.ML] 2026 年 6 月 2 日arXiv:2606.03736v1 [stat.ML] 02 Jun 2026

用于顺序定价的资源受限自适应推理Resource-Constrained Adaptive Inference for Sequential Pricing

Ruicheng Ao E-mail: aorc@mit.edu, jsjiang@ust.hk, dslevi@mit.edu. Institute for Data, Systems, and Society, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, MA 02139 Jiashuo Jiang Department of Industrial Engineering and Decision Analytics, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Hong Kong David Simchi-Levi Institute for Data, Systems, and Society, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, MA 02139 Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering and Operations Research Center, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, MA 02139
摘要Abstract

资源受限的定价控制器可能使固定价格推断变得不可能：控制器的资源状态可能会从可行集中删除目标价格邻域，即使每个已实现的操作都具有已知的正密度。我们通过本地非识别结果和实现的信息时钟来形式化这种支持排除失败。然后，我们设计了一个目标感知定价控制器，用于验证可行的目标频段并记录连续的局部密度。局部去偏提供学生化间隔，其宽度由该时钟控制。由此产生的遗憾信息核算（以飞行员解决错误为依据）表明，廉价的探索可能不足以进行推理：多项式目标质量给出多项式速率，而纯Resource-constrained pricing controllers can make fixed-price inference impossible: the controller’s resource state may remove the target price neighborhood from the feasible set, even when every realized action has a known positive density. We formalize this support-exclusion failure through a local non-identification result and a realized information clock. We then design a target-aware pricing controller that certifies feasible target bands and logs continuous local densities. Localized debiasing gives studentized intervals whose width is governed by this clock. The resulting regret–information accounting, stated up to pilot re-solving error, shows that cheap exploration can be insufficient for inference: polynomial target mass gives polynomial rates, while a pure1/t1/t如果没有额外的局部移动，目标分支不会产生缩小的固定目标间隔。实验表明，当资源状态崩溃目标支持时，可在认证范围内进行校准并放弃诊断。target branch does not yield shrinking fixed-target intervals without additional local movement. Experiments show calibration in certified bands and diagnostic abstention when the resource state collapses target support.

关键词：Keywords:动态定价、资源约束、自适应推理、置信区间、重新求解、收益管理dynamic pricing, resource constraints, adaptive inference, confidence intervals, re-solving, revenue management

1 简介Introduction

销售易腐烂资源（航空公司座位、酒店房间、季节性零售库存）的公司动态设定价格，同时从这些价格产生的销售中了解需求。同样的定价系统也越来越多地被要求支持推论：销售季节结束后，分析师想要特定需求敏感性的置信区间，例如价格效应Firms that sell perishable resources—airline seats, hotel rooms, seasonal retail inventory—set prices dynamically while learning demand from the sales those prices generate. The same pricing systems are increasingly asked to support inference as well: after a selling season, an analyst wants a confidence interval for a specific demand sensitivity, such as the price effectβj​(p♯)\beta_{j}(p^{\sharp})以管理上相关的价格at a managerially relevant pricep♯p^{\sharp}。困难在于，用于此推断的数据是由定价政策本身产生的，并且该政策在严格的资源限制下运行。. The difficulty is that the data used for this inference were produced by the pricing policy itself, and that policy operates under hard resource constraints.

在无约束的自适应实验中，这种推断的障碍是常见的：如果策略很少访问目标价格，则那里的倾向很小，并且逆密度修正变得不稳定。资源限制造成了更大的障碍。剩余资源状态可以删除邻域In an unconstrained adaptive experiment, the obstacle to such inference is familiar: if the policy visits the target price too rarely, the propensity there is small and inverse-density corrections become unstable. Resource constraints create a sharper obstacle. The remaining-resource state can remove a neighborhood ofp♯p^{\sharp}完全从可行的价格设定中。一旦发生这种情况，目标效果就不会被不精确地估计；它在已实现的实验中不存在，并且记录数据的重新加权无法恢复它。from the feasible price set altogether. Once that happens, the target effect is not estimated imprecisely; it is absent from the realized experiment, and no reweighting of the logged data can recover it.

一个简单的例子使区别变得具体。考虑从乐队开始的单一产品控制器A simple example makes the distinction concrete. Consider a single-product controller that begins with the band[p♯−h,p♯+h][p^{\sharp}-h,p^{\sharp}+h]可行的。在一阵高消费销售爆发后，剩余资源迫使该区间内的每个价格都违反所有后续轮次的容量限制。控制器仍然发布可行价格并在其上记录连续密度，因此普通重叠保留在已实现的可行集上。然而，两条平滑、稀疏的需求曲线可以在每个公布的价格上一致，并且仅在排除的范围内不一致。因此，可行集的重叠并不意味着固定目标的重叠，仅靠倾向校正无法识别feasible. After a burst of high-consumption sales, the remaining resource forces every price in that band to violate the capacity constraint for all later rounds. The controller still posts feasible prices and logs a continuous density on them, so ordinary overlap holds on the realized feasible set. Yet two smooth, sparse demand curves can agree on every posted price and disagree only inside the excluded band. Overlap on the feasible set therefore does not imply overlap for the fixed target, and propensity correction alone cannot identifyβj​(p♯)\beta_{j}(p^{\sharp}).

我们将这种现象作为资源受限自适应采样下的推理问题来研究，以动态定价作为运行应用程序。在每一轮中，控制器都会观察协变量和资源状态，发布可行的价格，赚取收入并消耗资源。推理目标是低维坐标We study this phenomenon as a problem of inference under resource-constrained adaptive sampling, with dynamic pricing as the running application. At each round the controller observes covariates and a resource state, posts a feasible price, earns revenue, and consumes resources. The inferential target is a low-dimensional coordinateβj​(p♯)\beta_{j}(p^{\sharp})高维稀疏需求模型。约束障碍是局部信息而不是自适应性本身：当资源状态排除目标邻域时，坐标在局部变得不可观测。因此，有效的推理必须是支持感知的，具体取决于控制器提供的样本路径，而不仅仅是事后应用的估计器。of a high-dimensional sparse demand model. The binding obstacle is local information rather than adaptivity per se: when the resource state excludes the target neighborhood, the coordinate becomes locally unobserved. Valid inference must therefore be support-aware, depending on the sample path the controller makes available and not only on the estimator applied after the fact.

最近关于自适应推理、离策略评估和实验设计的工作分析了在线决策如何影响有效性和精度Recent work on adaptive inference, off-policy evaluation, and experimental design analyzes how online decisions affect validity and precision(Deshpande et al., 2018; Dimakopoulou et al., 2021; Zhang et al., 2020; Duan et al., 2024; Simchi-Levi and Wang, 2023)。在这些设置中，统计对象通常是分配概率或分配规则，并且操作集始终保持可用。在资源约束下，可行性本身成为统计设计的一部分：当资源状态达到约束面时，目标区域可能会消失，因此重叠是受控状态的属性，就像日志记录策略的属性一样。关于受限在线分配和安全顺序决策的并行文献研究了预算、背包和安全限制下的相关性能问题. In those settings the statistical object is typically the assignment probability or allocation rule, and the action set remains available throughout. Under resource constraints, feasibility itself becomes part of the statistical design: a target region can disappear when the resource state reaches a constraint face, so overlap is a property of the controlled state as much as of the logging policy. A parallel literature on constrained online allocation and safe sequential decision making studies the associated performance problem under budgets, knapsacks, and safety restrictions(Badanidiyuru et al., 2018; Agrawal et al., 2016; Agrawal and Devanur, 2016)。我们在统计实验的层面上将这两种观点联系起来：资源约束不仅决定了哪些政策是可行的，还决定了哪些影响仍然可以从实现的路径中识别出来。. We connect the two views at the level of the statistical experiment: resource constraints govern not only which policies are feasible, but also which effects remain identifiable from the realized path.

我们的控制器使用目标感知边界吸引重新求解。重新解决适合资源受限定价，因为该策略必须重复地将剩余资源状态映射到可行的定价区域，并且现有分析表明，精心设计的重新解决规则在容量限制下提供后悔保证Our controller uses target-aware boundary-attracted re-solving. Re-solving suits resource-constrained pricing because the policy must repeatedly map the remaining resource state into a feasible pricing region, and existing analyses show that carefully designed re-solving rules deliver regret guarantees under capacity constraints(Jasin, 2014; Bumpensanti and Wang, 2020; Wang and Wang, 2022; Ao et al., 2025a)。我们将遗憾与稳定缓冲液重新解决进行基准比较，因此遗憾声明是根据受控操作参考来衡量的。新的成分是经过认证的目标局部记录：当完整的目标带位于已解析的可行集内时，控制器会为其分配一个已知的连续密度。这将足以满足低后悔的控制信息与局部激励信息（置信区间所需的目标区域变化）分开。给定结果样本，估计器是目标坐标的局部逆密度去偏；可选的居中增强通过条件居中删除可预测的分数分量，但无法创建控制器从未生成的支持。. We benchmark regret against a stabilized buffered fluid re-solve, so the regret statement is measured against a controlled operating reference. The new ingredient is certified target-local logging: when the full target band lies inside the resolved feasible set, the controller assigns it a known continuous density. This separates control information, which can suffice for low regret, from local excitation information, the target-region variation required for confidence intervals. Given the resulting sample, the estimator is a localized inverse-density debiasing of the target coordinate; an optional centered augmentation removes predictable score components by conditional centering, but cannot create support that the controller never generated.

因此，部署后推理不能与生成数据的控制器分开，该控制器不仅确定哪些价格有利可图，还确定哪些价格影响在统计上仍然可见。我们做出四项贡献。首先，我们将支持排除隔离为一种独特的故障模式，在这种模式中，即使每个已实现的操作都带有记录的密度，目标也会消失。其次，我们引入了一种已实现的信息时钟，它用目标局部信息代替标称地平线作为控制间隔宽度的量。第三，我们设计了一种推理感知的解决策略，将目标支持视为在线设计约束，并将其与局部逆密度去偏配对，并将中心控制变量作为可选的细化。第四，我们证明遗憾控制和有效推理遵循不同的时钟：对数曝光足以满足遗憾，但对于固定目标推理来说仍然太薄。当资源状态崩溃目标支持时，实验记录了校准的工作频带、预测的信息时钟斜率、高维去偏和诊断放弃。Post-deployment inference therefore cannot be separated from the controller that generated the data, which determines not only which prices are profitable but also which price effects remain statistically visible. We make four contributions. First, we isolate support exclusion as a distinct failure mode, in which the target disappears even though every realized action carries a logged density. Second, we introduce a realized information clock that replaces the nominal horizon with target-local information as the quantity governing interval width. Third, we design an inference-aware re-solving policy that treats target support as an online design constraint and pair it with localized inverse-density debiasing, with centered control variates as an optional refinement. Fourth, we show that regret control and valid inference obey different clocks: logarithmic exposure can suffice for regret while remaining too thin for fixed-target inference. Experiments document calibrated operating bands, the predicted information-clock slopes, high-dimensional debiasing, and diagnostic abstention when the resource state collapses target support.

At the main-text level, the theorem needs four primitive ideas: a regular sparse local model, martingale-type adaptive noise, a recurrent operating-band condition for the target price, and a pricing policy that logs a continuous local density whenever that target band is viable.

第四个要求是目标价格的运行区间条件。在完全支持证书验证整个内核带位于已解析的可行集中之后，控制器激活目标本地 Wald 分支。在附录中，我们通过定价原语、目标储备警卫和流动规模的资源验证来表达此证书。当证书处于活动状态时，控制器会为全频段分配绝对连续的密度。这些设计步骤意味着目标带可用性、有界局部权重、局部稀疏革兰氏稳定性以及学生化所需的鞅正则性。从经济上讲，估计值附加到控制器通过上下文、资源缓冲区或记录的扰动继续访问的常规销售范围。The fourth requirement is an operating-band condition for the target price. The controller activates the target-local Wald branch after a full-support certificate verifies that the entire kernel band lies in the resolved feasible set. In the appendix we express this certificate through pricing primitives, a target-reserve guard, and a fluid-scaled resource verification. When the certificate is active, the controller assigns the full band an absolutely continuous density. These design steps imply target-band availability, bounded localized weights, localized sparse Gram stability, and the martingale regularity needed for studentization. Economically, the estimand is attached to a regular selling range that the controller continues to visit through contexts, resource buffers, or logged perturbations.

3 目标感知定价控制器Target-Aware Pricing Controller

推理层构建在受约束的连续动作控制器之上。控制器采用边界吸引解析来适应推理目标：它在生成具有足够目标区域信息的样本路径的同时保留较低的遗憾。因此，该政策将本地支持认证为在线设计的一部分，而不仅仅是记录已实现的行动密度，并且其目标分支维持支持而不是充当通用探索。The inferential layer is built on top of a constrained continuous-action controller. The controller adapts boundary-attracted resolving to an inference objective: it retains low regret while generating a sample path with enough target-region information. The policy therefore certifies local support as part of the online design, beyond simply logging the realized action density, and its target branch maintains support rather than serving as generic exploration.

6 相关工作Related Work

定价、资源限制和重新解决。Pricing, resource constraints, and re-solving.

具有需求学习的动态定价在估计未知需求模型的同时设定价格，半短视和强盗式政策实现了近乎最优的遗憾Dynamic pricing with demand learning sets prices while estimating an unknown demand model, with semi-myopic and bandit-style policies achieving near-optimal regret(Keskin and Zeevi, 2014; Goldenshluger and Zeevi, 2013; Bastani et al., 2021)，包括个性化变体, including personalized variants(Ban and Keskin, 2021)、零售分析管道, retail analytics pipelines(Ferreira et al., 2016)，以及需求错误指定的明确处理, and explicit treatments of demand misspecification(Ren and Van Roy, 2024)。资源限制又增加了一层，因为它们决定了哪些政策是可部署的以及勘探如何使用稀缺的能力. Resource constraints add a further layer, since they determine which policies are deployable and how exploration spends scarce capacity(Brantley et al., 2020; Chen et al., 2024; Ao et al., 2024a, b)：带着背包的强盗为预算内奖励最大化提供了学习理论基础: bandits with knapsacks give a learning-theoretic foundation for reward maximization under budgets(Badanidiyuru et al., 2018; Agrawal et al., 2016; Agrawal and Devanur, 2016)，保守或安全的配方尊重性能底线, conservative or safe formulations respect performance floors(Wu et al., 2016)，收入管理解决使用流动基准和反复重新优化来管理库存，最近的分析通过控制扰动、简并和边界行为获得有限的、恒定的或对数的遗憾, and revenue-management re-solving uses fluid benchmarks and repeated re-optimization to manage inventory, with recent analyses obtaining bounded, constant, or logarithmic regret by controlling perturbations, degeneracy, and boundary behavior(Gallego and Van Ryzin, 1994; Jasin, 2014; Ao et al., 2025b; Bumpensanti and Wang, 2020; Wang and Wang, 2022; Li and Ye, 2022; Jiang et al., 2025; Ao et al., 2025a, 2026c)。整个文献都以收入或遗憾为目标，并将需求参数视为定价手段。相反，我们以固定价格预先分配的需求系数作为推理目标，因此边界吸引重新求解必须承担双重职责：它仍然控制后悔，但它也确定实现的约束实验是否携带足够的局部信息以进行推理. This entire literature targets revenue or regret and treats demand parameters as a means to pricing. We instead make a preassigned demand coefficient at a fixed price the inferential target, so boundary-attracted re-solving must do double duty: it still controls regret, but it also determines whether the realized constrained experiment carries enough local information for inference onβj​(p♯)\beta_{j}(p^{\sharp}).

自适应推理、重叠和去偏。Adaptive inference, overlap, and debiasing.

在统计方面，自适应收集数据的在线推理研究顺序决策如何影响置信区间On the statistical side, online inference for adaptively collected data studies how sequential decisions affect confidence intervals(Deshpande et al., 2018; Hadad et al., 2021; Zhang et al., 2020; Khamaru et al., 2025; Li and Zheng, 2021)，反复出现的教训是，与政策一起设计时，不确定性估计是最稳定的, with the recurring lesson that uncertainty estimates are most stable when designed together with the policy(Dimakopoulou et al., 2021; Duan et al., 2024; Simchi-Levi and Wang, 2023)预测可以指导努力的方向and that predictions can guide where effort is spent(Ao et al., 2024c)。离策略评估通过逆倾向和双重稳健修正重新衡量记录的操作. Off-policy evaluation reweights logged actions through inverse-propensity and doubly robust corrections(Dudík et al., 2011)，由内核平滑以进行连续处理，与我们的局部估计器完全相同, smoothed by a kernel for continuous treatments exactly as in our localized estimator(Kallus and Zhou, 2018)，并且具有约束的高维上下文强盗提出了我们必须控制的相同的滋扰维度问题, and high-dimensional contextual bandits with constraints raise the same nuisance-dimension issues we must control(Ma et al., 2024)。用因果推理的术语来说，我们的失败模式是有限重叠或正性违规：当访问目标的倾向消失时，逆权重估计器失去规律性，并且目标被不规则地识别. In causal-inference terms our failure mode is a limited-overlap or positivity violation: when the propensity to visit the target vanishes, inverse-weight estimators lose regularity and the target is irregularly identified(Rosenbaum and Rubin, 1983; Khan and Tamer, 2010; Crump et al., 2009)，这种效果在高维度上变得锐利, an effect that sharpens in high dimensions(D’Amour et al., 2021);区别在于，资源限制使这种重叠故障成为控制器状态的内生因素，而不是由协变量分布固定。估计器建立在去偏高维推理的基础上; the distinction is that resource constraints make this overlap failure endogenous to the controller’s state rather than fixed by the covariate distribution. The estimator builds on debiased high-dimensional inference(Javanmard and Montanari, 2014; Van de Geer et al., 2014; Zhang and Zhang, 2014; Chernozhukov et al., 2018; Athey et al., 2018)以及经典的半参数效率和渐近统计工具包and the classical semiparametric-efficiency and asymptotic-statistics toolkit(Van der Vaart, 2000; Tsiatis, 2006)，具有局部多项式欠平滑目标步骤, with a local-polynomial undersmoothed target step(Fan and Gijbels, 1996)，非参数聚合传统中的稀疏率, sparse rates in the nonparametric aggregation tradition(Tsybakov, 2004)，以及差异会计的可预测控制变量, and predictable control variates for variance accounting(Greensmith et al., 2004; Schulman et al., 2016; Ao et al., 2026f)。在这些方面，行动集仍然可用，推理成本来自不均匀的抽样或低倾向；在我们的设置中，可行性是资源路径内生的，因此重叠是受控状态属性以及日志记录策略属性。自适应推理、背包强盗、收入管理解决和连续行动离策略评估各自具有其中一些特征，但没有一个将资源引起的目标支持损失视为中心推理对象。. Across these lines the action set remains available and the inferential cost comes from uneven sampling or low propensities; in our setting feasibility is endogenous to the resource path, so overlap is a controlled-state property as well as a logging-policy property. Adaptive-inference, bandits-with-knapsacks, revenue-management re-solving, and continuous-action off-policy evaluation each share some of these features, but none treats resource-induced loss of target support as the central inferential object.

7 结论Conclusion

我们将资源受限的顺序定价视为统计设计问题，其中数据由定价政策生成。控制器必须赚取收入，但它也确定目标价格区域是否仍然可观察，因此边界吸引重新求解除了控制遗憾之外还具有统计目的：它有助于保留稀疏推理所依赖的局部实验。We have treated resource-constrained sequential pricing as a statistical design problem in which the data are generated by the pricing policy. The controller must earn revenue, but it also determines whether the target price region remains observable, so boundary-attracted re-solving serves a statistical purpose in addition to controlling regret: it helps preserve the local experiment on which sparse inference depends.

由此产生的保证是共同的且依赖于制度的。当实现的定价路径通过内生价格变动或通过奖励本地目标记录提供不同的本地信息时钟时，对数后悔与有效的推理配对。中心增强是可选的，并且由相同的实现的约束样本控制。在目标邻域离开已实现路径的稀缺状况下，信息时钟诊断会识别崩溃边界，并且该方法将目标报告为不受支持，而不是返回标称区间。The resulting guarantees are joint and regime dependent. Logarithmic regret pairs with valid inference when the realized pricing path supplies a diverging local information clock, either through endogenous price movement or through reward-local target logging. The centered augmentation is optional and is governed by the same realized constrained sample. In scarcity regimes where the target neighborhood leaves the realized path, the information-clock diagnostics identify the collapse boundary, and the method reports the target as unsupported rather than returning a nominal interval.

一些扩展保留了这种结构。同样的论点涵盖了记录的未经审查的观察概率下的审查感知目标、最佳稀疏局部模型周围的近似线性以及目标价格的样本分割选择，每个内容都在附录中开发。局部约束实验的更清晰的效率理论以及多个同时目标坐标的处理是未来工作的自然方向。Several extensions preserve this structure. The same argument covers censoring-aware targets under logged uncensored-observation probabilities, approximate linearity around a best sparse local model, and sample-split selection of the target price, each developed in the appendix. A sharper efficiency theory for the localized constrained experiment, and the treatment of several simultaneous target coordinates, are natural directions for future work.

该证明将四个技术模板分开，这些模板通常合并在自适应定价论点中。该论文仅使用高维推理来隔离低维坐标，仅在将估计量转换为鞅分数后使用自适应去偏，仅通过目标局部密度和带宽进行连续动作推理，仅通过资源可行性和基准对象进行定价理论。附加步骤是所有四个模板必须由相同的已实现支持流程编制索引The proof separates four technical templates that are often merged in adaptive-pricing arguments. The paper uses high-dimensional inference only to isolate the low-dimensional coordinate, adaptive debiasing only after converting the estimator to a martingale score, continuous-action inference only through target-local density and bandwidth, and pricing theory only through the resource feasibility and benchmark objects. The additional step is that all four templates must be indexed by the same realized support process{χt♯,αt♯,BT​(p♯)}\{\chi_{t}^{\sharp},\alpha_{t}^{\sharp},B_{T}(p^{\sharp})\}.

故障源自控制器侧而不是估计器侧。崩溃发生在应用任何去偏差校正之前：受约束的定价路径在目标邻域中生成的观测值太少，或者将太多的质量集中在单侧边界区域上，以致局部设计无法以稳定的方式增长。由于中心控制变量是根据相同的已实现历史构建的，因此它无法更改收集的目标邻域观测值。特别是，它不能改变The failure originates on the controller side rather than the estimator side. The collapse occurs before any debiasing correction is applied: the constrained pricing path generates too few observations in the target neighborhood, or concentrates too much mass on a one-sided boundary region, for the localized design to grow in a stable way. Because the centered control variate is built from the same realized history, it cannot change which target-neighborhood observations were collected. Therefore CVD may still lower variance relative to IPW on the surviving observations, but it cannot recreate missing local information for local inverse-density inference once the constrained design has effectively excludedp♯p^{\sharp}。预算紧张的实验例证了这种故障模式。 ∎. The tight-budget experiments instantiate this failure mode. ∎

在小的规格误差下，控制器侧信息条件仍然是限制因素，而轻微的近似误差只会将目标移动一定的量，该量在与推理极限相同的范围内消失。 ∎The controller-side information condition remains the limiting factor under small specification error, while mild approximation error only shifts the target by an amount that disappears at the same scale as the inferential limit. ∎

本附录将数字证据扩展到正文估计器比较之外。我们记录间隔校准、更广泛的资源阶段扫描和真实数据重放检查。证据支持机制级别的解释，而不是独立于设置的估计量排名：目标支持是方差减少增益的先决条件。当受限样本仍然包含可预测的分数变化时，CVD 会有所帮助，而受限设计会在局部信息崩溃时限制推理。This appendix expands the numerical evidence beyond the main-text estimator comparison. We document interval calibration, broader resource-phase scans, and real-data replay checks. The evidence supports a mechanism-level interpretation rather than a setting-independent estimator ranking: target support is a precondition for the variance-reduction gains. CVD helps when the constrained sample still contains predictable score variation, while the constrained design limits inference when local information collapses.

我们围绕理论流程而不是估算器名称来组织数值部分。实验询问控制器是否离开经过认证的本地实验，实现的时钟是否以预测的速率增长，诊断失败是否会产生弃权，以及可选的中心增强是否仅在支持存活后才改变方差。We organize the numerical section around the theory pipeline rather than around estimator names. The experiments ask whether the controller leaves a certified local experiment, whether the realized clock grows at the predicted rate, whether diagnostic failure produces abstention, and whether the optional centered augmentation changes variance only after support survives.

该表并不是为了调整新的高维算法；而是为了调整新的高维算法。它检查证明中使用的理论成分是否有对应的经验成分。去偏坐标的 RMSE 低于正则化导频，间隔宽度随局部 ESS 缩小，并且覆盖范围接近较大局部信息体系中的标称值。剩余的有限样本覆盖率与论文的主要诊断信息一致：局部 ESS 和加权分数稳定性，而不是单独的日历范围，决定了区间可靠性。The table is not meant to tune a new high-dimensional algorithm; it checks that the theoretical ingredients used in the proof have an empirical counterpart. The de-biased coordinate has lower RMSE than the regularized pilot, the interval width shrinks with the localized ESS, and coverage is close to nominal in the larger local-information regimes. The remaining finite-sample undercoverage is consistent with the paper’s main diagnostic message: local ESS and weighted-score stability, not the calendar horizon alone, determine interval reliability.

B.5 在线零售重播压力测试Online Retail Replay Stress Tests

图FigureB.7通过三个额外的重播系列来补充正文库存扫描：价格对变化、探索率变化和客户细分变化。这些重播继承了与正文重播相同的缺货截断，并且应被解释为描述性的稳健性检查。supplements the main-text inventory sweep with three additional replay families: price-pair variation, exploration-rate variation, and customer-segment variation. These replays inherit the same stockout truncation as the main-text replay and should be interpreted as descriptive robustness checks.

更广泛的重播证据并不支持独立于设置的排名。资源限制和自适应定价会产生状态扭曲的推理问题，当这种扭曲可预测到足以利用时，CVD 通常会比 IPW 有所改进。真实数据的比较是依赖于设置的，因此分析强调机制和边界条件，而不是通用排序。The broader replay evidence does not support a setting-independent ranking. Resource constraints and adaptive pricing produce a state-distorted inferential problem, and CVD often improves over IPW when that distortion is predictable enough to exploit. The real-data comparison is setting dependent, so the analysis emphasizes mechanisms and boundary conditions, not a universal ordering.
